text:
alex Hey folks — I pushed the PATCH for the shared scheduler and addressed the comments from @maya. PTAL when you have a minute.

maya Thanks Alex — reading now. I see you squashed the perf test fix into the same commit, can you split into two? Easier to reason in the changelog.

alex Good call. Re-split and updated CHANGELOG.md. Also added a short note about the benchmark variance. Squashed history in the branch 'scheduler/fix-split-changelog'.

luis Quick Q: does this change the default backoff for cold start retries? That came up in the rollback test.

alex It preserves the old default; I added an explicit unit test to assert backoff==200ms. See test_scheduler_backoff in scheduler_test.go

maya LGTM on logic. Leaving two tiny nits inline about var names and a log statement. Not blockers but prefer they land before canary.

alex Fixed both nits and force-pushed. Also ran a local canary run — everything green except the flaky e2e that times out; unrelated per logs.

ci-bot Build passed — checks: go/unit, go/integration, lint. e2e flaky; rerun scheduled.

luis Thanks. Can you also add a short note in the PR description about the fallback policy so on-call knows where to look if it regresses?

alex Done — PR description updated with fallback policy and rollback instructions.

maya PTAL again @alex — if no more comments I'll merge and schedule a small canary tomorrow morning (US-PST 08:30). Could you be available for post-deploy monitoring?

alex I'll be around for that slot and can watch traces/latency. 

luis :thumbsup: Good to go from me after you confirm canary time.

maya OK wrapping up — merging once CI rechecks the e2e. Thanks both. :tada:
